sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Rajnish Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Tanisha Jahangir Monir Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant-accused, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
None has appeared on behalf of complainant.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in case crime No.32 of 2021,
under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, police station Naseerpur, District Firozabad with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant-accused that the applicant-accused is innocent and he has not committed any offence.
The first information report was lodged against applicant and one unknown person, alleging that on 28.01.2021, the applicant has enticed away her minor daughter.
Alleged incident has been shown of 28.01.2021 but first information report has been lodged on 24.02.2021.

In her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., victim girl has stated her age as 19 years and she has stated that she has gone with applicant-accused to Mathura with her Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74568458/
1 own free will and they have married with each other and she is having pregnancy of two months and she wants to go with applicant.

Learned counsel further submitted that statement of victim has already been recorded before the Trial Court, wherein, she has stated that she herself has left her home and went to applicant-accused and that applicant has not committed any rape upon her.
She did not support prosecution version and she was declared hostile.

It was also pointed out that in her cross examination, she has inter-alia stated that later on she has married with applicant-accused and out of that marriage, she has one child and that she is still living with applicant.
Learned counsel submitted that in view of statement of victim, no useful purpose would be served to keep the applicant in jail.
It was pointed out that victim herself has stated her age as 19 years.

Lastly, it has been submitted that the applicant-accused is languishing in jail since 24.09.2021, having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant-accused is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

Let the applicant-accused Mahaveer involved in aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
1. The applicant-accused shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
2. The applicant-accused shall not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
3. The applicant-accused shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
4. The applicant-accused shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

5. The applicant-accused shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant-accused in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 20.4.2023 Neeraj  Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74568458/
